messages:
pagerbot: INCIDENT PAGE - sev1 - enterprise tenant "olympus" in us-east-1 showing ~40% 5xxs and elevated tail latency across dedicated pool-42. Pager routed to oncall-sre.

Alisha: Got the page, I'm on it. Can someone post the root request id example and the tenant id? I can't access the customer's console until we confirm isolation steps.

Sev: tenant id TEN-OLYMPUS-01. First saw error spike at ~13:10 UTC, errors mostly on model inference backends (cuda OOMs intermittently) and repeated model-fallbacks causing throttle cascades. Tracing shows heavy p99 latency on frontend-proxy->pool-42 nodes.

Matt: Confirming GPU nodes in pool-42 are flagged with intermittent memory pressure. Node 42-7 and 42-8 have repeated eviction logs. Attaching recent log snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T13:12:07Z] pool-42-7 kernel: OutOfMemory: failed to allocate 1.2G for KV cache
[2026-03-15T13:12:09Z] runtime: model_runner[resnet-small]: restart due to OOM
[2026-03-15T13:12:15Z] pool-42-8: healthbeat: degraded - batch queue length 24
```

Irene: Customer-facing note: Samir from Olympus is in the customer_ops thread. Samir — are you seeing client-side errors? Anything you can share on recent traffic spikes or special jobs?

Samir (Olympus): We're seeing client retries and a few failed uploads reported by our ingestion pipeline. No planned heavy jobs. We're getting reports from a production feature toggle rollout at ~13:00 UTC - could be related. Happy to throttle on our side if needed.

Alisha: Thanks. Plan A: isolate tenant from pool-42 to a warm pool (warm-olympus-1) and shift traffic to us-east-1b warm capacity while we heal pool-42. Plan B if warm pool insufficient: use cross-region failover to us-west-2 but that requires DNS TTL considerations. We should coordinate low-ttl DNS cutover if we go that route.

Sev: How healthy is warm-olympus-1? Last sync was 12:40 UTC, has quantized model variants baked. Capacity shows 20% headroom for current QPS if we disable optimistic batching.

Matt: warm-olympus-1 node list: w-1..w-6. CPU/GPU memory nominal. I can bring two extra warm nodes up to ramp. It will take ~90s per node to attach to the tenant routing table.

oncall-sre: @Alisha take lead. I'll coordinate the routing changes and update the incident channel.

Alisha: On it. Steps:
1) Pause new requests to pool-42 for TEN-OLYMPUS-01 via tenant routing tag.
2) Allow in-flight requests to drain (30s), set drain timeout to 60s.
3) Attach warm-olympus-1 to tenant routing with weight=100.
4) Monitor 5xx and tail latency for 5m. If stable, decommission tenant traffic from pool-42.

Matt: Ready to execute step 3. Running command to attach:
```
redwoodctl route attach --tenant TEN-OLYMPUS-01 --pool warm-olympus-1 --weight 100 --no-commit
# verifying
redwoodctl route commit --tenant TEN-OLYMPUS-01
```

Alisha: Executing step 1 now: `redwoodctl route set --tenant TEN-OLYMPUS-01 --pool pool-42 --weight 0 --drain 60` - setting to drain.

pagerbot: ACTION - routing weight change queued by Alisha at 2535008888.

Sev: Noting that pool metrics: error rate dropped 10% after initiating drain but still spiky. Batching at warm pool needs batching disabled to reduce memory peaks.

Alisha: For warm pool attach, also toggling runtime flag to disable optimistic batching for this tenant: `config set TEN-OLYMPUS-01.optimistic_batching=false` - applying now.

Matt: Warm pool nodes attached. Commit done. Traffic shift started.

Irene: Samir, you should start seeing decreased errors on your client. We'll monitor but please keep us posted.

Samir (Olympus): Seeing immediate reduction in failed requests in our telemetry. Thank you. A few retries still happening but trending down.

Sev: Monitoring p95/p99. p95 down from 2.4s -> 1.1s within 45s of shift. 5xxs trending towards baseline. Marking preliminary mitigation success.

Alisha: Leaving pool-42 in drain for another 5m to ensure no tail retries. Matt, could you snapshot the affected nodes before any reboots and escalate to infra if they keep OOMing?

Matt: Snapshotting logs + kernel vmstat. If nodes keep OOMing after tenant evac, I'll open infra-runbook with cloud team. For now nodes show GC spikes correlated with large prefix cache loads.

pagerbot: INCIDENT UPDATE - mitigation applied: tenant traffic shifted to warm pool; optimistic batching disabled for tenant; monitoring window started. Pager escalations suppressed for this tenant.

oncall-sre: Opening post-incident checklist early: need RCA on why warm pool capacity was only 20% headroom and why pool-42 experienced sudden memory pressure. Also check canary config - why optimistic batching was on by default for this enterprise tenant.

Irene: I'll draft customer-facing timeline. Quick note for support playbook: offer Olympus a 2-hour post-incident review and share logs/metrics. Samir — would you like a private postmortem session with infra and product?

Samir (Olympus): Yes please, we'd appreciate a deeper take. Our engineers are available tomorrow 14:00 UTC.

Alisha: Setting tentative postmortem slot. For now, keeping monitoring window open 30m. We should also consider a low-ttl DNS plan if warm pool had been exhausted and we needed cross-region shift - but since warm attach succeeded, no DNS cutover needed.

Sev: Adding follow-ups:
- ticket INFRA-OLY-472: investigate pool-42 eviction patterns
- task RUNTIME-983: adjust default batching policy for enterprise tenants with large KV caches

Matt: I will also scrub the node images and schedule a rolling reboot for pool-42 nodes during low traffic.

pagerbot: SEV1 -> status changed to mitigated (impact reduced). Incident will remain open for RCA and customer follow-up. Incident channel will keep monitoring thread active.

Alisha: Thanks everyone. Final check: Samir, any residual client errors to report?

Samir (Olympus): Minor retry spikes but negligible. We're good for now. Thanks for the quick reroute.

Irene: Closing immediate handoff. Oncall will continue to watch for 30m and then hand to SRE day team. @oncall-sre - please confirm when handoff complete.

oncall-sre: Handoff scheduled at 2535013200. I'll post final note and tracking tickets then.

pagerbot: INCIDENT THREAD CLOSED FOR HANDOFF at 2535013200 by oncall-sre. All actions tracked: INFRA-OLY-472, RUNTIME-983, PMT-OLY-2026. :white_check_mark:
